title: Investment Ombudsman officer to be named after ASEAN week — Remulla
summary: MANILA – An Investment Ombudsman officer may be named after the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit week, Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla said on Friday.
